messages:
Maria: Quick sync — we have three Preview customers (CodaHealth, NorthStar.ai, LatticePay) who agreed to short follow-up interviews next week to capture product-fit + onboarding pain points. Need help coordinating times, NDAs for one legal-sensitive customer, and sending $25 gift codes after interviews.

Jon: Awesome — which of those are high renewal-risk vs health check? I can prioritize. :mag_right:

Maria: NorthStar.ai flagged renewal risk (low usage, complaining about latency on long docs). CodaHealth is neutral but wants tighter enablement. LatticePay is healthy.

Sam: I can run a Doodle / calendar poll. Proposed slots: Mon 9–11am PT, Tue 1–3pm PT, Thu 10–12pm PT. I'll post a link. :calendar:

Elena: For the NDA — CodaHealth shared a one-way NDA that legal wants redlined. Can you drop the doc here or DM me? Also confirm whether interviews will record audio.

Maria: Not planning to record, just notes. I'll upload CodaHealth NDA in #legal-review but pinging you too, @Elena.

Sam: Poll live: https://doodle.mock/s/preview-interview-poll — please add preferred slots and mark timezones. I can auto-add calendar invites after responses.

Jon: For gift codes — do we have a global code flow or unique codes per participant? Last time support had collisions.

Maria: We should use unique codes. Support confirmed we can generate Stripe/Promo codes via the portal. I'll get a batch and hand them off in-thread after each completed session.

SurveyBot: Hi! I created a short post-interview survey and auto token generator. Link: https://survey.mock/r/preview-postinterview — generate one-time token per participant with `!token create <email>` in DM.

Elena: Thanks @SurveyBot — I'll wait on the NDA redlines then sign. Maria, can you confirm which customers need the one-way NDA vs standard?

Maria: CodaHealth wants one-way (their IP). NorthStar okay with standard. LatticePay standard.

Sam: Scheduling note — I blocked tentative slots on my calendar as "Preview interview (tentative)" so invites go out quickly after poll closes. Will add Zoom links.

Jon: I'll prep a 6-question discussion guide (5–10 min each) focusing on: onboarding steps, signal gaps, quantifying latency pain, and willingness to try Dedicated. Will post in this thread by EOD.

Maria: Perfect. After interviews we'll: 1) post a short summary in customer health dashboards, 2) attach survey responses, 3) send gift code + thank-you note. Who volunteers to draft the summary?

Elena: I can draft the CodaHealth summary (incl. NDA context).

Sam: I'll collate times & survey tokens, and handle invites.

Jon: I'll do the NorthStar analysis and run a quick cost/latency recommendation to share with eng.

Maria: Great — thanks team. Quick action items recap: Sam = run poll & invites, Elena = NDA + CodaHealth summary, Jon = discussion guide + NorthStar analysis, Maria = generate gift codes + follow-up notes. I'll close the poll Wed 3pm PT. :white_check_mark:
